title: Source authority policy
description: Which source is authoritative for one measurement (output, state or rate) on a unit, when and to what it falls back, and who may override. Spec SRC01 (one authority per unit/product/measurement/interval; fallback segments with banner; overlaps reconciled on return), SRC02 (explicit and derived events for the same stop become one impact occurrence), ACT02/ACT05 (output counted once; coverage from the active source). Decision D05 (PI Production Output event frames primary, totalizer delta fallback). Consumed by sub-phase 1.10 (`AuthorityService`, `source_segments`) and 2.4 (ActualsRunner method selection).

source.description: `pi_output_ef` Production Output event frames (incremental quantities); `pi_counter` totalizer delta with rollover rule; `pi_rate` rate tag integration; `mqtt`/`kafka` counter or rate signals from those adapters; `manual` governed manual entry (ACT06); `external_report` a certified external daily-production record (ACT08) whose UTC boundaries equal the period (added in 2.4).

measurement.description: The measurement this policy governs. One policy per (scope, productId, measurement) is effective at a time (SRC01).

productId.description: Restrict to one product; null applies to every product on the scoped unit(s).

fallback.description: Fallback source and the conditions that activate it. Null = no fallback: when the primary is unavailable the interval is `missing` (null quantity), never estimated (ACT05).

conditions.description: `primary_stale`: no primary observation within cadenceSeconds x staleSampleFactor; `primary_bad_quality`: quality bad/uncertain; `primary_missing`: no primary mapping for the interval; `primary_conflict`: primary disagrees with the fallback beyond conflictTolerance (fallback is then used only after review).

source.description: Must differ from primarySource (checked by the service, not expressible here).

cadenceSeconds.description: Expected delivery cadence of the primary source (PI05 default polling 60 s); drives staleness detection together with `state_rules.staleSampleFactor`.

conflictTolerance.description: Relative disagreement |primary - fallback| / |primary| above which a `source_conflict` review item is raised when both sources cover the same interval (T12). 0 = any disagreement is recorded. Only the primary quantity is ever used; this never averages sources.

overrideRole.description: Minimum role allowed to force a different active source for an interval; the override is audited and creates a `source_segments` row with reason.
